description.value: Cougar Mountain Lodge & Resort sits outside Valemount in the Robson Valley, surrounded by 360-degree views of the Rocky, Cariboo, and Monashee Mountains. The property offers main lodge rooms and individual mini chalets accommodating groups of one to twelve, with self-catering facilities available. Valemount is an established mountain biking destination, and the lodge explicitly markets mountain bike storage as a service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms the lodge is active with 2025 booking references. A dedicated 'Mountain Bike Storage' page appears in the site navigation menu, providing positive evidence that bike storage is an offered service, though the subpage content was not captured so specific details (locked, capacity, etc.) are unknown. Phone, address, and website all cross-check between OSM and the website.
concerns: The 'Mountain Bike Storage' subpage (/mountain-bike-storage) was not captured in the fetch, so storage details (security method, capacity, e-bike charging) remain unverified — a follow-up contact with the property is recommended.
OSM address field reads '4540 North Highway 5' while the website consistently uses '4540 Highway 5 North'; minor word-order discrepancy, same location.
OSM community is tagged 'Unknown / Cariboo, Chilcotin & Central Interior' but Valemount is in the Robson Valley / North Thompson corridor — community tag may need correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active lodge in Valemount with an explicit Mountain Bike Storage service page; Valemount is a known cycling hub, making this a clear fit for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website references cooking facilities in the main lodge vacation rental. The lodge lists on AirBnb and Booking.com in addition to direct booking.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: We understand that the mini chalets aren't the best resource for storing mountain bikes after a long day. Don't worry, we have a solution for you and your valued mountain companion!
